key_findings: IQM-PC332 reduced mechanical hypersensitivity in CCI rats by both intraplantar and intraperitoneal routes.
In DRG neurons it inhibits IA, T-type and HVA Ca2+ and TRPV1 currents and reduces firing in neuropathic neurons.
